item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00331","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C06","C12","C17"],"selected_candidate_label":"C06","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C06 is a direct and material drafting template. Both orders establish a Presidential commission to resolve a transportation-labor controversy, then follow nearly the same operative sequence: define the parties and dispute; authorize investigation and inquiry aimed at a presidential report and amicable settlement; authorize public hearings and witnesses; require federal-agency cooperation and information; and provide presidentially fixed compensation or allowances. Much of the child's wording is nearly verbatim from C06, with airlines and flight-engineer issues substituted for rail carriers and operating-union proposals. C12 and C17 share portions of the generic commission machinery and some close formulations, but neither matches the child's dispute-resolution purpose and integrated structure as closely as
